name: Shiperman for WooCommerce
author: shiperman

sections.description:
This plugin enables easy and efficient international shipping from multiple European countries to destinations worldwide starting at €3.79. You can quickly automate AWB label creation and customize shipping rates based on your business needs.

Features:
– Ship from NL, DE, IT, ES, HU, PL, CZ, BG, RO, and UA to worldwide locations.
– Rates start from €3.79.
– Set up your account in under 5 minutes.
– Automatically generate AWB (Air Waybill) labels for shipments.
– Adjust shipping pricing with customizable multipliers:
– Add a margin (e.g., 1.2) for profit on shipping rates.
– Reduce rates (e.g., 0.9) to increase sales volume.

Benefits:
– Automates AWB creation for faster processing.
– Saves time with an easy-to-use interface.
– Reduces shipping costs, increasing your business efficiency.
– Offers flexibility in pricing to meet business goals.

External services

**Integration with Shiperman API **
This plugin relies on the Shiperman API for its core functionality. Below is an outline of the integration:
The Shiperman API is a third-party service used for automating logistics processes, including AWB (Air Waybill) label generation, real-time shipping rate calculation, and managing shipment statuses.

What data is sent and when:
– During AWB label creation: Shipment details such as recipient name, address, product weight, and dimensions are sent to the Shiperman API.
– During shipping rate calculation: Origin and destination addresses, along with package dimensions and weight, are sent to the API.
– For account setup and authentication: Account credentials and related configurations are shared during setup.

Links to the Shiperman service
– https://shiperman.com/#about-us
– https://shiperman.com/#contact-us
– https://shiperman.com/terms
– https://shiperman.com/privacy-policy

Support

For support or feature requests, please contact info@shiperman.com or visit https://shiperman.com.
sections.installation:
1. You need to have an existing WooCommerce shop.
  2. Upload the plugin files or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to the plugin settings page to configure your account and shipping preferences.
  5. Configure your products’ weight and dimensions if you have not.
  6. Ship away with Shiperman!
sections.faq:
How do I set up the plugin?

The setup process is simple. Go to the plugin settings page, create your account, and start shipping in under 5 minutes.

Can I adjust the shipping rates?

Yes, you can use pricing multipliers to add a profit margin or offer discounted rates for your customers.

Is AWB creation automated?

Yes, AWB labels are generated automatically for your shipments.
